conbody.p: Additional cargo space is provided to accommodate long/narrow cargo (skis, poles, etc.) not able to fit properly in the tailgate when closed.

li.p: Pull the cover down while pushing the release lever down.

note.p: Cargo should always be secured to prevent it from being thrown about the vehicle in a collision and causing injury to the vehicle occupants. Do not place objects in the rear seats, since they cannot be properly secured and may hit the front seat occupants in a collision.
